dataset: BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset v1.0.0 (PhysioNet), Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
citation: Pimentel MAF et al., Towards a robust estimation of respiratory rate from pulse oximeters, IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 64(8):1914-1923, 2017.
method: Sliding 25-second windows every 60 seconds. The algorithm (web/src/live/ppg.js, the same one the phone-camera feature uses) estimates heart rate from the finger PPG; the reference is the mean ECG-derived heart rate over the same window. Only windows the app would accept (quality "good") count towards the error.
limits: Pulse-oximeter PPG from hospital patients, not phone-camera video. It validates the signal processing on real pulse waveforms and noise, not the camera, its optics or motion on a real phone.
provenance: Numbers copied from the log of GitHub Actions run 43542695347 (workflow 'Validate pulse algorithm'), because the team network could not download the run's artifact. Re-run the workflow to reproduce.
